what: ShipSense evidence_audit_chain + commitment_log head anchor. Hashes and counts only — contains no shipment, merchant, courier or personal data.
chain_digest_method: sha256(row_hash joined by '|' in ascending id order)

commitment_log.digest_method: sha256(entry_hash joined by '|' in ascending seq order)

notes: Row ids are a sparse Postgres sequence: head_row_id >= chain_row_count always. A gap in ids is not a missing row.
schema_version 2 files (2026-07-15 to 2026-08-16) carry a field named rows_in_chain that actually holds head_row_id, not a count. See SCHEMA.md. Those files are left in place unedited.
From schema_version 4 a <anchor>.proofs.json beside this file may carry OpenTimestamps and RFC-3161 timestamps of this file's exact bytes. See SCHEMA.md.
